en.name: Rice milk
en.summary: Rice milk is milled rice cooked and pressed into a thin, faintly sweet drink, sold chilled or in shelf-stable cartons. Keep it refrigerated and go by the use-by date on an unopened pack; once opened, use it within 7–10 days.
en.pantry: An unopened aseptic carton keeps in a cool cupboard to its printed date, because it was sterilised and filled sealed. A chilled carton is a different product and must stay cold — follow the 2-hour rule, or 1 hour if the kitchen is above 32 °C (90 °F). Once opened, neither kind belongs in a cupboard. Rice milk is low in acid and contains plenty of available starch sugars, so it ferments readily if it is left warm.
en.fridge: Keep it at 4 °C (40 °F) or below on an inside shelf rather than the door. Unopened chilled cartons run to the use-by date on the package. After opening, use it within 7–10 days with the cap closed and the carton upright. Rice milk settles more than most plant drinks — a chalky layer of starch on the bottom is normal, not spoilage — so shake it well before pouring and judge it on smell and taste rather than on the sediment.
en.freezer: There is no published freezer timeline for rice milk, and freezing suits it poorly: the starch retrogrades as it freezes and the thawed drink is gritty and separated in a way that shaking will not fix. If you have to, freeze it at −18 °C (0 °F) in a container with headspace and use it in porridge, baking or a smoothie rather than in a glass. Buying a smaller carton is usually the better answer.
en.thawing: Thaw in the fridge, never on the counter, and shake or blend hard. Expect a grainy texture and use it in cooking. Do not refreeze.
spoilage: A sour, sharp or yeasty smell rather than a faint sweet-cereal one.
A fizz or hiss on opening, or a swollen carton.
Ropy, slimy or gluey strands when you pour.
Mould around the spout or cap, or visible growth in the liquid.
tips: Shake hard before every pour; sediment is normal and misleads people.
Write the opening date on the carton.
Do not drink from the carton if you are keeping the rest.
Buy small cartons if you only use it occasionally.

faq.q: How long does rice milk last after opening?
faq.a: About 7–10 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept closed and upright.

faq.q: Does rice milk need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: Chilled cartons do, and unopened ones go by the use-by date. Aseptic shelf-stable cartons can stay in the cupboard until opened.
There is no established timeline, and it thaws gritty because the starch retrogrades. Freeze it only for cooking, at −18 °C with headspace.

faq.q: Why is there a layer at the bottom of the carton?
faq.a: Rice starch settles. That is normal — shake it back in. Judge spoilage by smell and taste, not by sediment.

zh.name: 米漿（米奶）
zh.summary: 這裡的米漿指的是把米煮過壓榨而成、質地稀薄帶淡甜味的西式米奶，有冷藏與常溫利樂包兩種。請冷藏保存，未開封以包裝有效日期為準；開封後請在 7～10 天內喝完。
zh.pantry: 未開封的無菌利樂包放在陰涼櫥櫃可以到標示日期，因為它經過滅菌並密封充填。冷藏包裝是另一種產品，必須全程保冷——請守 2 小時原則（廚房超過 32 °C 時為 1 小時）。一旦開封，兩種都不能回到櫥櫃。米漿酸度低、又含有不少可利用的澱粉糖，放在溫暖環境很容易發酵。
zh.fridge: 放在 4 °C 以下的內側層架，不要放門邊。未開封的冷藏包裝以有效日期為準。開封後請在 7～10 天內用完，蓋子關緊、盒身直立。米漿比多數植物奶更容易沉澱——底部一層粉白色澱粉是正常的，不是壞掉——倒之前用力搖勻，並以氣味和味道判斷，不要靠沉澱判斷。
zh.freezer: 米漿沒有公告的冷凍期限，而且它不適合冷凍：澱粉在冷凍過程中會老化回凝，解凍後粗糙分離，怎麼搖都回不來。真的要凍，請放 −18 °C 並在容器留膨脹空間，之後用在粥、烘焙或果昔，不要直接倒來喝。買小包裝通常是更好的答案。
zh.thawing: 放冷藏解凍，不要放室溫，之後用力搖勻或打勻。質地會偏粗，請用於料理。不要再次冷凍。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸、刺鼻或有酵母味，而不是淡淡的穀物甜香。
開封時冒泡或有嘶聲，或包裝鼓脹。
吸嘴或瓶蓋周圍長霉，或液體中看得到菌落。
tips: 每次倒之前用力搖；沉澱是正常的，但常被誤判。
還要留著喝的話，不要直接對著盒口喝。
偶爾才喝的話請買小包裝。

faq.q: 米漿開封後可以放多久？
faq.a: 蓋緊直立放 4 °C 以下，大約 7～10 天。
冷藏包裝一定要，未開封以有效日期為準。無菌常溫利樂包在開封前可放櫥櫃。
沒有既定期限，而且澱粉老化會讓它解凍後變粗糙。只建議冷凍後用於料理，放 −18 °C 並留膨脹空間。
是沉下去的米澱粉，正常現象，搖勻即可。判斷有沒有壞要靠氣味和味道，不是靠沉澱。
